snippet.title: Forgotten Station - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Embark on a one of a kind trip, aboard Forgotten Station.

In this knowledge-based narrative game, you will travel aboard trains to find your way out of a time loop. Your curiosity and observation skills will be put to the test in this relaxing game, filled with atmospheric places to uncover, characters to meet, and real human stories.

Wishlist and try the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4522330/Forgotten_Station/

Music Composer: Grayson DeSmet
Trailer made by Deborah Tetart (Helianott), with the help of Roy Acquasaliente
Original Sound Design by Florian Baudoux, with added work by Roy Acquasaliente
